name: Amineptine
summary: Amineptine, formerly sold under the brand name Survector among others, is an atypical antidepressant of the tricyclic antidepressant (TCA) family. It acts as a selective and mixed dopamine reuptake inhibitor and releasing agent, and to a lesser extent as a norepinephrine reuptake inhibitor.

pharmacology.text: Amineptine inhibits the reuptake of dopamine and, to a much lesser extent, of norepinephrine. In addition, it has been found to induce the release of dopamine. However, amineptine is much less efficacious as a dopamine releasing agent relative to D-amphetamine, and the drug appears to act predominantly as a dopamine reuptake inhibitor.

uses.text: Amineptine was approved in France for severe clinical depression of endogenous origin in 1978.

zhOther: 安咪奈丁, 安撲丁, 氨奈普汀
summaryZh: 阿米庚酸，又名安咪奈丁、氨奈普汀、安撲丁，是一種具有三環類抗抑鬱藥結構的非典型抗抑鬱藥。其作用機理主要是作為選擇性和混合性多巴胺再攝取抑制劑及釋放劑，及一種較弱的去甲腎上腺素再攝取抑制劑而起作用。

sideEffects.en: It was withdrawn after reports of severe acne, liver damage and dependence, with people seeking it out for its stimulant-like effect. Other reported effects include sleeplessness, agitation and headache.
sideEffects.zh: 它在出現嚴重痤瘡、肝損傷與成癮的報告後下市，有些人為了它類似興奮劑的作用而刻意尋求使用。其他回報的反應包括失眠、躁動與頭痛。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它在出现严重痤疮、肝损伤与成瘾的报告后下市，有些人为了它类似兴奋剂的作用而刻意寻求使用。其他回报的反应包括失眠、躁动与头痛。

fact.en: It is a tricyclic antidepressant that behaves quite unlike the others: it works mainly on dopamine rather than serotonin or noradrenaline, which is also why it came to be misused.
fact.zh: 阿米庚酸是一種行為與其他三環抗憂鬱劑大不相同的藥物：它主要作用於多巴胺，而非血清素或正腎上腺素，這也是它後來遭到濫用的原因。
fact.zhHans: 阿米庚酸是一种行为与其他三环抗忧郁剂大不相同的药物：它主要作用于多巴胺，而非血清素或正肾上腺素，这也是它后来遭到滥用的原因。
